text: Make a 20-second audio intro for my podcast, Small Wonders. A warm female voice should say: “Welcome to Small Wonders, the show about big ideas hiding in everyday life. I'm Maya. Let's get curious.” Put upbeat, gentle electronic music underneath, with a little music-only opening and a smooth fade at the end. One finished audio file, please. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so please tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?
